Creative Strategy

MWM.ai

MWM.ai

95
medium riskConcept pending
Personal angle
Creator-marketer who runs a multi-tool content stack (ChatGPT + image gen + CapCut + captions) consolidates it inside MWM.ai — one tab instead of four. Honest verdict: it's a workspace, not a miracle. If you know what you're making, it shaves real time.
Next action
map GTM content strategy + first batch of campaign posts (committed May 27)

Hook options (5)

  • 1.I tried making this whole TikTok in one tab instead of four. It worked. I'm annoyed.
  • 2.My content stack is four tabs. I rebuilt it inside one AI tool. Verdict in 30 seconds.
  • 3.I review AI tools for a living. This one didn't waste my time.
  • 4.If your AI workflow is six tabs and three logins, this video is for you.
  • 5.AI tool reviewed honestly. Yes that's the whole hook.

CTAs

  • Primary: Link's create.mwm.ai if you want to test it yourself.
  • Secondary: If your stack is leaking subscriptions, worth thirty minutes — create.mwm.ai.
  • Tertiary: Worth a look if you're tired of context-switching across four tools — create.mwm.ai.

ParakeetAI

ParakeetAI

92
medium risk Concept approved
Personal angle
Marketing/AI operator who can DO the work but freezes when asked to package it in a live interview. ParakeetAI = the live-answer layer that closes the gap between knowing it and saying it cleanly.
Next action
Awaiting brand reply

Hook options (5)

  • 1.When your interview brain deletes your entire career.
  • 2.POV: you know the work. The interview decides otherwise.
  • 3.I have years of AI workflow experience and zero ability to explain it on a Zoom call.
  • 4.The job is one thing. Explaining the job in an interview is a separate sport.
  • 5.My resume can talk. My mouth in a live interview cannot.

CTAs

  • Primary: Link in bio — ParakeetAI.
  • Secondary: Save this if you've also blanked mid-answer.
  • Tertiary: Comment your most cursed interview moment.

Creator-marketer who is 'fully median' at sustainability does Phobaxx 30-day challenge — posting the honest version including the days she forgets, doesn't believe in it, and the days something actually clicks. Anti-preachy, anti-aesthetic-pantry framing.
Next action
start mapping GTM content strategy May 27; awaiting clarification on 30 posts video-only vs photo/carousel

Hook options (5)

  • 1.Sustainability content on TikTok is one of two things: a girl with a perfectly aesthetic pantry, or someone yelling at me about my coffee cup. I'm doing this challenge for 30 days because I wanted a third option.
  • 2.I make UGC for a living, which means I see every brand frame sustainability badly. So when one of them asked me to actually do a 30-day challenge, I went in fully skeptical.
  • 3.I'm not a sustainability girlie. I recycle when I remember. I drive an old car. I order takeout. And I just signed up for a 30-day challenge to see what happens.
  • 4.Day 1 of doing something I have zero qualifications for: a 30-day sustainability challenge as someone who is fully median at this.
  • 5.Climate content makes me feel either guilty or fake-inspired, and I'm tired of both. So I'm trying a 30-day thing — out loud, on camera, without pretending I'm transformed.

CTAs

  • Primary: Follow along for the full 30 days — I'll tell you if it doesn't work.
  • Secondary: If you're tired of either the aesthetic-pantry camp or the guilt-trip camp, this one's for you.
  • Tertiary: Day 1 of 30. TikTok + Instagram. #phobaxx
